messages.en: I can't believe it's already our final showㅠㅠㅠ
It feels like just yesterday we were all busy preparing for the tour,
and after traveling through so many cities,
we've already made it to the LA concertㅜㅠ
I'm really, really sad it's ending,
because the whole tour has been nothing but wonderful memories,
so part of me wishes we could do a few more citiesㅎㅎ
During this tour,
I feel like I've grown so much,
and by performing on so many stages,
I got to practice
how to look cooler on stage,
and how to look like I'm having fun.
I think I had so many chances to work on that,
so this tour
has become something really meaningful to me.
It played a huge role in helping me grow,
and people around me even told me how much I've improved,
which made me feel like all my hard work
really showed. I'm so happy.
The fact that
so many fans came to cheer us on in all these different cities
still feels so amazing to me,
and I'm so thankfulㅠㅠ🥲
The Seoul concert is still left,
so it's not completely over yet!
Thank you, WAV, for making this world tour possible...
I'll never forget it. Really.
I know I still have a lot to improve,
and I know I still have a long way to go,
but just like I said at the beginning,
I promised I'd keep showing you a Hayeon who's always growing.
I'll keep working even harder.
Since it's the final show,
I wanted to share
a few of my thoughts.
Sorry, sorry.
I'm back after recharging a bit.
It's already dawn. Aren't you tired?
I've got stamina made of steel now.
No, but seriously...
If anyone wants to build up their stamina,
I highly recommend going on tour.
Ah, me?
Let's go.
Around the Orlando shows,
all of us
would finish the performance,
"Waaah..."
"We gave it everything."
"Phew..."
We'd be completely exhausted,
that's how it used to be.
Now we're all
totally fine even right after a performance.
It doesn't even faze us anymore.
"Great job, everyone!!! Thank you, thank you!"
Even our energy is completely different now.
Hayeon, your English is really good.
ㅋㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㄹㅋㅋㄹㄹㅋ
I'm fine, thank you, and you!
"Hi guys, I'm so happy and sad. Bye."
No, no.
What I was actually trying to say was,
"Today's concert made me so happy,
but I'm sad because now we have to say goodbye."
I literally translated that.
It was part of the concept~
It was cute, wasn't it?
Go have a yogurt drink.
Anyway, right now
half of my suitcase
is filled with American snacks.
I've also got maple syrup I bought in Canada,
plus all sorts of other things.
My suitcase is about to burst.
I have to give
presents
to my family and the members.
But seriously...
I'm performing and even running on the treadmill,
so if I'm still gaining weight...
just how much of a calorie bomb is American food!!!!!
This is driving me crazy.
For my gift, I'll take the Abu Dhabi vlog.
Why is it both funny and sad that it still hasn't been uploaded?
ㅋㄹㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹ
Do you ever get embarrassed filming vlogs?
Queens don't worry about things like thatㅎ
If there are too many people around,
I'll just pretend I'm on a video call with Y/n~
"Yeah~ I'm in LA right now~"
"What are you up to~~"

messages.ko: 근디 어차피 LA면 다들 못 알아듣지 않을까 너의 말
messages.en: But since you're in LA, wouldn't nobody understand what you're saying anyway?
Then I'll just do it in English.
"Hi, I'm fine thank you, and you?"
That'll do.
Wow, Jeong Hayeon, your English is seriously amazing (;;;
Pretty cool, right? Pretty cool?
How about a girl who can hold an entire conversation with just one sentence?
Traveling in America?
Just trust me.
I'll take care of everything.
Here you go~
It's a photo of the highest calories and the prettiest girl.
If I say 'the highest calories,'
I know what you're going to say.
I already predicted the jokeㅎㅎ If you weren't going to make it, then sorryㅎㅎ
I just called myself out on my own, yep.
Didn't you spill something on your hair???
Yep, I spilled it while carrying it.
Is the donut huge, or is your face just tiny?
Bothㅎㅎ
Though the second one
might have a slightly bigger shareㅎㅎ
The donut was pretty big too, though.
That's the story.
Tomorrow I have my schedule,
then I'm going to have some fun.
I think I'll enjoy LA a bit~~
Yep, I'm starting to get sleepy.
It's 2 a.m.
Yep, it's late. You should sleep so you're ready for tomorrow!!
Yep, yep.
Hayeon is going to get a good night's sleep.
I'll message you later💕
Haranghae😚
